title: The Cloudferry Race
story: Veskaline the Vapor Serpent has coiled around the sky-ferry's mooring rope and is chewing through it at a steady pace. The rope is 96 feet long and she gnaws 8 feet every 5 minutes; Mr 6 can re-braid rope from the other end at 4 feet every 5 minutes. Below, a basket of sleepy owl-chicks dangles.
question: If Veskaline eats 8 feet of rope every 5 minutes while Mr 6 braids on 4 feet every 5 minutes, how many minutes until the 96-foot rope is gone?
hint: Every 5 minutes the rope gets shorter by 8 minus 4 feet. How many of those 5-minute chunks fit into 96 feet?
victory: Mr 6 announced the rope would last two full hours — more than enough time — and Veskaline, who hated being predictable, uncoiled in embarrassment and drifted away as a polite little cloud.
imagePrompt: A long translucent vapor serpent coiled around a thick rope beneath a floating sky-ferry, dawn clouds glowing pink, a tiny caped numeral six braiding rope at the far end.
